annotations.text:
M0 — the walking skeleton.

These four screens are the entire first milestone. Nothing else ships until one real sale writes an invoice, its line items, a payment, an allocation, two stock-ledger rows and a balanced journal entry — atomically, in one transaction.

The POS counter is live: tap items, change quantities, charge, count out cash. The 8-second bill is meant to be timed, not asserted.

Two alternates, kept honest.

The main screens commit to one direction — Bazaar Ledger: ink on paper, rules instead of shadows, tabular money. B and C move on different axes (literacy-density, and what the app is for) so the choice is real. Each carries its own tradeoff, not just a case for the favourite.

Say the word and either one becomes Main.

Two things on the receipt are legal decisions, not visual ones.

The Raast alias prints as plain text. Minting a scheme QR is an offence under s.56 of the PS&EFT Act — up to 3 years or PKR 3m — because SBP issues those first two digits only to licensed PSO/PSPs. A bank-issued QR can be imported and printed; we never synthesise one.

And nothing anywhere claims the bill was filed with FBR.
